messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary health checks failing for rollout hotpatch v2.3.1 in eu-west-1. Error-rate 5.1% (threshold 1%), 500s up, memory usage +35%. Pager -> @jay.sre :rotating_light:
camila.deploy: rolled v2.3.1 to 5% canary ~00:02 UTC. I'm seeing increased 500s on /generate and occasional OOM logs from model-worker-2.
jay.sre: I'm on it. First pass: confirm scope and whether rollback/kill-switch is needed. Any customer-facing errors reported?
camila.deploy: quick query from metrics: spike started ~00:04 UTC, affects only eu-west-1 canary traffic. No global routing yet.
morgan.support: support queue: 12 reports in last 5m referencing 500s from inference endpoint. No P0 customers so far, one mid-market customer filed a ticket (#3421).
oliver.eng: if it's isolated to the canary we can kill the feature flag first and drain canary. Manual rollback across region is heavier. Recommend flip flag and drain traffic, then rollback if it persists.
jay.sre: agreed. Steps: 1) Flip ff_hotpatch -> off in eu-west-1 only. 2) Drain canary nodes. 3) Watch 5m error rate and latency. If error-rate >1% persists after drain, initiate rollback to v2.3.0.
camila.deploy: preparing commands. Executing feature flag toggle now:
```
$ ops-cli feature-toggle set ff_hotpatch false --env prod --region eu-west-1 --reason "canary errors"
Success: ff_hotpatch=false (scoped to eu-west-1)
```
camila.deploy: flipping now.
deploy-bot: command received: feature-toggle set ff_hotpatch=false region=eu-west-1 by camila.deploy at 5812343270
jay.sre: good. Start draining canary pools. Use drain id canary-581234 for audit.
camila.deploy: starting drain:
```
$ ops-cli drain canary --id canary-581234 --region eu-west-1 --timeout 300
Draining 5% canary -> removing from LB
Drained nodes: model-worker-1, model-worker-2
Result: drain initiated, expected tests to pass within 2m
```
camila.deploy: model-worker-2 emitted OOM during drain but process restarted. Logs attached (link)
jay.sre: running smoke checks now. smoke script: ./scripts/smoke-check.sh eu-west-1
jay.sre: smoke results: 20/20 health endpoints OK, sample generate request 10/10 successful, 500-rate dropped to 0.2% after drain. Latency normalizing.
oliver.eng: thumbs up. Let's keep observation window for 10m then mark canary as healthy/unhealthy. If healthy we stay rolled back (flag off) and re-evaluate patch. If errors reappear, full rollback.
kate.pm: customer impact summary for comms: 12 tickets, no data loss, transient errors only. Escalation not required yet, but keep support updated.
morgan.support: updating ticket #3421 with current mitigation: feature flag disabled, canary drained, monitoring ongoing.
jay.sre: monitoring graphs look stable for 6m. Error-rate at 0.15%, memory back to baseline. I will leave the on-call watch for another 10m.
camila.deploy: scheduling a conservative rollback to v2.3.0 in eu-west-1 for 00:25 UTC in case we see regression. For now rollback is on standby.
oliver.eng: action items: (1) postmortem stub (camila + jay) (2) reproduce locally with canary config (eng), (3) add OOM guard in model-worker (runtime).
jay.sre: closing notes: mitigation performed: ff_hotpatch disabled, canary drained, smoke tests pass. No immediate customer-critical impact. Will re-open if metrics degrade.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied at 5812343325 by camila.deploy; status: mitigated -> monitoring.
morgan.support: support update posted. Marking affected tickets as "monitoring".
camila.deploy: I'll coordinate a follow-up RFC for safer rollout gating and add a forced mem-check in canary.
jay.sre: leaving on-call watch. If no regression by 00:45 UTC we'll resolve the incident.
oliver.eng: thanks all. :white_check_mark:
